usage: tr report [-h] [--horizon {day,short,swing}]
                 [--arm {champion,challenger}]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --horizon {day,short,swing}
                        one horizon (default: each, never pooled)
  --arm {champion,challenger}
                        one arm (default: champion, plus challenger once it
                        has a thesis)
